name: loka-preview
description: Preview a Loka Web module in VS Code.

loka.preview.module.description: Path relative to the first workspace folder to the JavaScript output of loka_add_web_app. The export name and companion .wasm file use the same stem.

loka.preview.buildCommand.default: emcmake cmake --preset web && cmake --build --preset web --target LokaHelloWeb
loka.preview.buildCommand.description: Shell command to build the preview module in the first workspace folder. The task shell must already have emsdk in its environment.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Preview runs workspace JavaScript and Wasm; Build runs a workspace shell command.
